items.item:
- DEP-001: the deployment requirements contain only `==` pins, one per direct
  import [witness: verification:dependency_pins_client_portal].
statements:
DEP-001: every library from outside its own source that the running
  portal imports directly is pinned to one exact version in the deployment
  requirements; the libraries pip resolves for them are not pinned.

verdicts.item:
- DEP-001: the deployment requirements contain only `==` pins, one per direct
  import [witness: verification:dependency_pins_client_portal].
statements:
DEP-001: every library from outside its own source that the running
  portal imports directly is pinned to one exact version in the deployment
  requirements; the libraries pip resolves for them are not pinned.
quotes: witness.expect(name not in pins, f"requirements.txt:{number} pins {name} twice")
witness.expect(not unpinned, f"direct dependencies without a pin: {unpinned}")
verdicts.why: The check rejects non-`==` requirement entries and duplicate pins, requires each detected direct external dependency to map uniquely and have a pin, and rejects pins that are not direct dependencies (or the explicitly included image entry). Thus direct dependencies are pinned exactly once while pip-resolved transitive dependencies cannot appear as extra deployment pins.
